summary: Design, test and harden prompts with explicit task, format, examples and injection guards.
intents: rewrite this system prompt so the model stops ignoring the format
why does my prompt give inconsistent answers
harden this prompt against prompt injection from user documents
turn these instructions into a reusable prompt template with variables
add few-shot examples to my classification prompt
prerequisites: the current prompt or the task it must perform
a few real inputs and the expected outputs if available

verify.description: The prompt has no critical findings (secrets, unfilled placeholders)

verify: Outputs were scored on the same sample inputs before and after the change
